pain_point: Tired of landlord controlling their space - My landlord won't let me modify the space for my business needs. I want my own place.
headline_pain: How Much Has Your Landlord Cost?
primary_text: "I want my own place." How much have you spent improving a building you don't own? Every modification you've made — partitions, flooring, electrical — stays with the landlord when you leave. Owner-occupiers in Truganina's new industrial precinct are building equity with every fit-out dollar. These off-the-plan warehouses come as brand-new shells ready for your vision. No lease restrictions. No landlord approval. No wasted capital. Located near the Princes Freeway and West Gate Tunnel, with warehouse and office configurations for trades, logistics, and manufacturing businesses.
description: Brand-new shell ready for your custom fit-out with no lease restrictions
